data.notes: December 2026 is already unusually well-confirmed for Berlin, with strong club programming around RSO, ://about blank, OST and RAW alongside pop/R&B/hip-hop concerts and major NYE weekender announcements.

events.title: RSO: NULL RESET — NYE 82HR WEEKENDER
events.summary: RSO’s NULL RESET NYE Weekender runs from 31 December 2026 through 4 January 2027 across three floors. The confirmed lineup includes Adiel, Akua, Alarico, Daria Kolosova, Freddy K, MARRØN, Josey Rebelle, JASSS, DJ Spit, NIKS, Schacke and more.

events.title: BCCO x 240KMH
events.summary: BCCO and 240KMH join for a large-scale NYE Berlin celebration at MUENZE beginning 30 December 2026. RA confirms a heavyweight techno bill including future.666, AEREA live, ÜBERKIKZ, BIIA, DJ Hyperdrive, Alycia Bezgo, WILDERÍCH b2b GIØ and many more.

events.title: GEGEN X PRNCPTL X OST NYE 34H
events.summary: GEGEN, Pornceptual and OST join forces for a 34-hour NYE event starting 31 December 2026. RA confirms a large queer techno and house lineup including Dr. Rubinstein, Hyperaktivist, Kiddy Smile, Spacer Woman, 2THEMAX b2b KEMIK and many more.

events.title: Polyamor x SESH
events.summary: Polyamor and SESH take over RAW- Lokschuppen plus Astra Kulturhaus for a two-venue NYE event beginning 30 December 2026. RA confirms a large trance/techno lineup including Paraçek, davyboi, Mika Heggemann, Cara Elizabeth, DJ DRECKISCH and Trancemaster Krause.

events.title: Sido – SIDOs Weihnachtsshow 2026
events.summary: Sido’s annual Weihnachtsshow run returns to Columbiahalle, with this representative date confirmed for 18 December 2026 at 20:00 on the artist’s Universal Music page. It is one of Berlin’s recurring German hip-hop holiday fixtures.

events.title: Renate NYE 2026/27
events.summary: Renate's 68-hour, five-floor NYE program features techno, house, EBM and breakbeat with Amy Dabbs, Evil B-Side Twins, Rachel Noon, Vio PRG, Zeynep and showcase crews.

events.title: Nia Archives – Emotional World Tour
events.summary: Nia Archives brings her Emotional World Tour to Berlin’s Uber Eats Music Hall on 1 December 2026. The official artist tour page lists the Berlin date and venue.

events.title: HEISSS I 30 hours
events.summary: HEISSS stages a 30-hour RSO weekender with Justine Perry x Paula Koski, Temudo and more TBA, centered on long-form techno with house edges.

events.title: OXI NYE - 60 Hours
events.summary: OXI marks the year change with a 60-hour queer and FLINTA-powered techno, house and disco session running through the first weekend of 2027.

events.title: REINKARNATION w/ DICE, Kamäleon, Limoncello, Pavello Promillo & Giorgio Inkasso, Benito
events.summary: NEUTRUM’s final REINKARNATION of 2026 is confirmed at ://about blank on 5 December 2026. The lineup includes DICE, Kamäleon, Limoncello, Pavelo Promillo b2b Giorgio Inkasso, BENITO, Alexa Fluor, Elias Nuit and Nassia BabyV.

events.title: REINKARNATION w./ DICE, Kamäleon, Pavello Promillo & Giorgio Inkasso, Limoncello, Benito
events.summary: NEUTRUM closes its 2026 REINKARNATION series at ://about blank with high-energy techno, bounce, trance and hardtrance across two floors.

events.title: BLN REUNION INDOOR FESTIVAL
events.summary: Winter indoor edition of BLN Reunion with three floors and 14 acts, including AKA AKA, K-Paul, Sascha Braemer, Blondee, Ostekke and more.

events.title: Bree Runway
events.summary: Bree Runway plays Säälchen Berlin on 1 December 2026 at 20:00. Ticketmaster lists the event as presented by Live Nation.

events.title: CONTR4ST pres. fka.m4a [6 hour set]
events.summary: CONTR4ST returns to Paloma on 6 December 2026 with fka.m4a playing a six-hour set and support from Orik. The RA page lists house and progressive house as the core sound.

events.title: AFRO HAUS XXL - Dezember Edition
events.summary: Three-floor diaspora party at Narva Lounge with Afrobeats, Amapiano, Hip Hop, UK sounds, Dancehall, Reggae and Soca, hosted by AFRO HAUS Soundsystem.

events.title: Shantel & Bucovina Club Soundsystem – Partizani Super Sonic Live Tour
events.summary: Shantel & Bucovina Club Soundsystem play SO36 on 1 December 2026, with doors at 19:00 and show at 20:00. SO36’s official ticket page describes a live club-culture set blending Balkan pop, global bass, diaspora beats and electro.

events.title: Amsterdam Techno Records and DEPOT BERLIN [Amsterdam & Berlin]
events.summary: Amsterdam Techno Records teams with DEPOT BERLIN at ://about blank on 12 December 2026. The RA listing confirms a three-floor techno lineup with Ángel Negrín, Solvados, Jasmin Giovanazzi, DEN!SE, Martxas, STASIC, Dave Mech live, Bokaric, s:mash and SIUL.

events.title: Small Great House 'Season Closing 2026' with Nat Wendell b2b Mike Starr
events.summary: Small Great Things' house/disco season closing at OXI, anchored by Nat Wendell b2b Mike Starr with more artists to be announced.

events.title: SIDOs Weihnachtsshow 2026
events.summary: Sido returns to Columbiahalle with his long-running Christmas show format, advertised by the venue as a festive evening with surprise guests from music and entertainment. The 2 December date is one of the confirmed 2026 performances listed by Columbiahalle.

events.title: Die Fantastischen Vier: Der letzte Bus – Final Tour
events.summary: German hip-hop pioneers Die Fantastischen Vier play Uber Arena Berlin on 17 December 2026. The official venue page lists the show as part of their final tour.

events.title: NIMO: Home Sweet Home Arena Tour 2026
events.summary: German rapper Nimo plays Velodrom Berlin on 12 December 2026 on his Home Sweet Home Arena Tour. Velodrom describes the Berlin stop as part of a double-header in December.

events.title: BAP: Fünfzig Jahre – Die Zielgerade Tour 2026
events.summary: Wolfgang Niedecken’s BAP play Uber Arena on 8 December 2026 as part of the band’s 50th-anniversary tour. The arena’s official event page confirms the date and tour title.

events.title: PiepShow - DecemberPiep
events.summary: PiepShow’s DecemberPiep is billed as a colourful queer techno rave at KitKatClub, spanning five dancefloors, 14 DJ artists, play areas, drag/comedy performance, shibari and a 14-hour programme across techno, hard techno, house, disco and trance/groove rooms.

events.title: PUR 2026
events.summary: German pop band PUR open their 2026 arena tour at Uber Arena Berlin on 2 December 2026. The official artist site lists the Berlin date and ticket link.

events.title: INNA: Echoes Tour 2026
events.summary: Romanian dance-pop artist INNA brings the Echoes Tour to Uber Eats Music Hall on 11 December 2026. The official venue page highlights her EDM, house and dance hits.

events.title: Matthias Reim: 35 Jahre “Verdammt, ich lieb’ dich”
events.summary: Matthias Reim visits Uber Arena on 28 December 2026 on his anniversary tour for “Verdammt, ich lieb’ dich.” The arena’s official page confirms the date and tour context.

events.title: Four Play
events.summary: Section 8’s sex-positive Four Play residency returns to KitKatClub with a multi-floor techno/house programme plus performances, interactive stations and a large awareness setup; the listing describes it as closer to a festival than a standard club night.

events.title: No Angels: It’s Christmas – Live in Berlin 2026
events.summary: No Angels celebrate their Christmas album with an exclusive Berlin concert at Uber Eats Music Hall on 18 December 2026. The venue page confirms the date, doors and start time.

events.title: Grobes Fest 2026: Slime + Focus. + Rantanplan + Knochenfabrik
events.summary: Grobes Fest brings Slime, Focus., Rantanplan and Knochenfabrik to Astra Kulturhaus on 28 December 2026. Eventim’s listing confirms the Berlin date, venue and lineup.

events.title: Sarah Brightman: A Winter Symphony
events.summary: Sarah Brightman brings her seasonal “A Winter Symphony” program to Tempodrom on 2 December 2026, with Tonči Huljić listed as support. The venue page confirms doors and start time for the Große Arena.

events.title: Northern Lite: Christmas Show
events.summary: Northern Lite’s Christmas Show is listed by Astra Kulturhaus for 19 December 2026. The venue schedule confirms the Saturday date, doors and 19:00 start.

events.title: Slave To The Rave 43
events.summary: Quest Agency’s recurring Berlin techno party lands at OST for its 43rd edition, explicitly framed around a no-photo, consent-led and anti-discrimination rave environment.

events.title: NEELIX Berlin
events.summary: A touring Neelix showcase at Kesselhaus, bringing the long-running Goa/progressive electronic act back to Berlin for an all-night techno-tagged event running from 22:00 to 08:00.

events.title: Jerome Froese: Rare Up Close – Live
events.summary: Jerome Froese performs at Privatclub on 12 December 2026, with the venue billing the show as electronic/guitartronica. The program includes solo work, reinterpreted Tangerine Dream material and new music.

events.title: Kinktastisch! Techno. Kink. Play
events.summary: A kink/fetish techno and tech-house party at Insomnia with MINJA, Epicx and Mia Mangata, plus a midnight show, play areas, dungeon spaces, a no-phone policy and an on-site awareness team.

events.title: YOUNG LOVE
events.summary: A long-running Insomnia sex-positive electro-house/techno night aimed at younger and young-at-heart clubbers, with tech house, techno and melodic techno, BDSM areas, a phone-free policy and awareness support.

events.title: Trance Baby Trance – Kinky Trance Party
events.summary: A dedicated sex-positive trance rave at Insomnia from the UNDR/Trance Baby Trance circle, pairing fast, euphoric rave electronics with phone-free play-friendly spaces, an inclusive door concept and trained awareness support.
